description:
The flat `dev/active/3f664839/` entry holds the preregistered rare-event design that gf2-sim validation identifies. Once validation no longer hard-codes its path, it moves under the permanent-statistics epic's directory.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The entry's files live under the canonical directory of epic b8206228, and each tracker document reference names the new path.
- [hard] REQ-02: The move commit changes no consumer code: rare-event artifact validation and its tests locate the design by content identity or through the configured repository root.
- [hard] REQ-03: The artifact-validation run recorded in the rare-event verdict baseline, repeated after the move, yields identical verdicts; the repeat run is appended to that record.
- [hard] REQ-04: Digest-pinned inputs keep their bytes; human-facing citations are repointed, and a link scan of the touched files reports no unresolved local link.
- [hard] REQ-05: The manifest records each moved row as complete, and the Rust CI gate passes.
- [hard] REQ-06: Scripts in each moved entry that name the entry's own directory by path literal are updated to the new path (path text only), and each such edit is recorded per entry in the commit message.
title: Move the 3f664839 design entry under its epic dir
